_comment: Audio licence provenance. Background music is the most common cause of YouTube Content ID claims, which strip monetisation and can escalate to strikes. Every bed used in a published video must have a recorded, verifiable licence. The compliance gate reads this file.
_how_to_fill: For each entry set licence to one of the acceptable values in compliance-policy.json legal.acceptable_audio_licences, paste the exact source_url you downloaded it from, and set verified_by and verified_on. Keep a copy of the licence page as a PDF alongside this file.
_warning: Files whose original source cannot be established should be replaced rather than guessed at. A wrong entry here is worse than an honest UNKNOWN.
